Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
None turned up on behalf of the complainant despite service of notice.
2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the applicant had enticed the victim on the false pretext of marriage and for a period of one year, physical relations happened in between them.
She also stated that on 3 to 4 occasions, abortion was also got done by the victim and subsequently the applicant is refusing to marry her.
A somewhat similar statement was given under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C.
The medical on record does not corroborate any allegation of sexual assault.
The tentative age of the victim is around 18 years.

3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.
4. Considering the fact that the relationship in between the applicant and the victim allegedly continued over a span of one year and the victim also became pregnant on 3-4 occasions, prima facie, a case for bail is made out considering the law as explained in the case of Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071, as such, the applicant who is in custody since 30.05.2024 is enlarged on bail.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
5. Let the applicant Adarsh Verma be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 0177 of 2024, under Sections 376, 313, 504, 506 IPC and Section 5(L)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Jaidpur, District Barabanki, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
